nodes.name: Read authorized trial balance
nodes.notes: Choose a dedicated private bearer credential, replace endpoint and both zero IDs, then enable this node for a manual run. Recipe is unverified in an installed n8n application.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item => { const text = item.json.content?.find(c => c.type === 'text')?.text; const result = item.json.structuredContent ?? (typeof text === 'string' ? JSON.parse(text) : text); if (!result?.data || result.data.balanced !== true) throw new Error('No balanced report returned. Check the connection and selected book.'); const d = result.data; const p = d.accounts.pagination; return { json: { summary: `Company ${result.company_id}, book ${result.book_id}: total debit ${d.total_debit} ${result.currency}, total credit ${d.total_credit} ${result.currency}. Balanced. Page ${p.page} of ${p.pages}.`, next_page: p.next_page, access_expires_at: result.access_expires_at, note: 'Totals cover the whole report; fetch next_page to inspect further account rows. No message was sent.' } }; });
